nodes.summary: For a variable change $C = (u, r, s, t)$ over a field $F$, the map $(x, y) \mapsto (u^2 x + r,\ u^3 y + u^2 s x + t)$ is a bijection $F^2 \to F^2$, whose inverse is the corresponding map of the inverse variable change $C^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Variable changes act bijectively on affine coordinates

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a field $F$, let $C = (u, r, s, t)$ be a variable change and let $C \cdot W$ be the transformed curve. The map $(x, y) \mapsto (u^2 x + r,\ u^3 y + u^2 s x + t)$ is a bijection from the solutions $(x, y) \in F^2$ of the Weierstrass equation of $C \cdot W$ onto the solutions in $F^2$ of the Weierstrass equation of $W$; its inverse is the corresponding map of $C^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Variable changes biject affine solutions

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a field $F$, let $C = (u, r, s, t)$ be a variable change and let $C \cdot W$ be the transformed curve. A pair $(x, y) \in F^2$ satisfies the Weierstrass equation of $C \cdot W$ if and only if $(u^2 x + r,\ u^3 y + u^2 s x + t)$ satisfies the Weierstrass equation of $W$.
nodes.title: Variable changes transform the Weierstrass equation

nodes.summary: For a variable change $C = (u, r, s, t)$ over a field $F$, with $u \in F^\times$ and $r, s, t \in F$, the affine coordinate map of $C$ sends $(x, y) \in F^2$ to $(u^2 x + r,\ u^3 y + u^2 s x + t)$.
nodes.title: Coordinate map of a Weierstrass variable change

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be an elliptic Weierstrass curve over a finite field $F$, let $C$ be a variable change and let $C \cdot W$ be the transformed curve. Then $C \cdot W$ and $W$ have the same number of rational points.
nodes.title: Variable changes preserve the point count

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be an elliptic Weierstrass curve over a field $F$, let $C = (u, r, s, t)$ be a variable change and let $C \cdot W$ be the transformed curve. There is a bijection from the rational points of $C \cdot W$ to the rational points of $W$, where in both cases the point at infinity is included; it sends the point at infinity to the point at infinity and an affine point $(x, y)$ to $(u^2 x + r,\ u^3 y + u^2 s x + t)$.
nodes.title: Variable changes biject rational points

nodes.summary: The ideal generated by `X - x` and `Y - y` is nonzero.
nodes.title: The ideal of a point on a Weierstrass curve is nonzero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
